name: Search MLB Player and Save Stats to JSON
prompt:
Use the MLB Stats API to look up Aaron Judge and save his player profile and most recent available season statistics to a file called player_stats.json.

The file must contain exactly these fields:
- player_id: the numeric MLB player ID (integer)
- full_name: the player's full name (string)
- position: position abbreviation such as 'RF' (string)
- team: full team name (string)
- jersey_number: jersey number as a string
- bats: batting side, e.g. 'R' (string)
- throws: throwing hand, e.g. 'R' (string)
- season: the season year as an integer
- stats_type: either 'batting' or 'pitching' (string)
- games: number of games played (integer)
- home_runs: home runs hit (integer, only for batting)
- avg: batting average as a string like '.331' or as a number (any format)
- ops: on-base plus slugging as a string or number

Use the MLB Stats API endpoints directly (no API key required). The base URL is https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1. Search for the player by name first to get the ID, then fetch their season stats. Save the result to player_stats.json.

criteria.description: player_stats.json file is present in the working directory.
player_stats.json parses as valid JSON without throwing an error.
player_stats.json contains all 13 required fields: player_id, full_name, position, team, jersey_number, bats, throws, season, stats_type, games, home_runs, avg, ops.
player_id is exactly 592450, Aaron Judge's official MLB player ID.
full_name contains 'Judge' (case-insensitive), confirming the correct player was retrieved.
team field contains 'yankee' (case-insensitive), confirming the New York Yankees affiliation.
position is a non-empty string representing a valid fielding position abbreviation.
season is a number between 2020 and 2026 inclusive, representing a valid recent MLB season year.
games is a positive integer greater than zero.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent was asked to look up Aaron Judge via the MLB Stats API and save structured stats to a JSON file.

Criterion 1: Data Accuracy (Weight: 60%)
1.0: player_id is Aaron Judge's correct MLB ID (592450), full_name matches, team is Yankees, stats reflect a real season with plausible values (HR > 30 for a typical Judge season).
0.5: Player identified correctly but some stat values are missing or from a placeholder.
0: Wrong player, or file is missing.

Criterion 2: JSON Completeness (Weight: 40%)
1.0: All 13 required fields are present with appropriate types.
0.5: Most fields present but one or two are missing.
0: File missing or fewer than half the fields present.
